reasons: Rule NOSOLICIT's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding Customer; the cited § 14.8 text concerns only supervision, assignment and subcontracting and imposes no solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction, so absence of such a covenant is genuinely compliant.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was proposed (rendered text is identical to the original) and no counterparty comment was generated — correct treatment for internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a defective clause and should not convert this into a deviation.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately notes the negative-search basis; nothing in the supplied text suggests a hidden no-hire or anti-poaching obligation on Customer.
